tasks.objective: On wholly synthetic data, make this offline escrow manifest validator reject mismatched table content digest, duplicate/invalid table IDs, truncated rows, and malformed timestamp. Add negative regression tests without any I/O, network or privileged data. Preserve valid cases and existing exported API.

Improve offline role inventory checks using synthetic role catalog only. Reject duplicate, missing or unexpected role identifiers and detect missing required synthetic privilege metadata, with negative tests. Never query a real DB.

Improve synthetic Auth configuration inventory verification, refuse incomplete metadata, detect duplicates and restrict sensitive key output without using secrets. Add isolation tests. Do not call hosted Auth.

Improve offline synthetic attendance event delta replay validation, detect duplicate IDs, out-of-order timestamps and missing original event references without writing DB. Add regression tests. Do not query operating records.

Build an offline metadata-only denied-environment-name validator for synthetic test descriptors, detecting high-privilege credentials by key NAME only and ensuring no values are ever returned. Add negative tests.

Offline synthetic recovery manifest hardening: reject null, primitive or array rows (each logical database row must be a plain object); safely reject unexpected nested types and ensure a malformed row cannot hide behind valid count and digest metadata. Preserve existing valid synthetic fixture and exported API. No production data, network, file I/O or secrets.

Pure synthetic role-catalog validation: prevent case-folded duplicate role IDs or privileged role name confusion, and reject malformed required privilege metadata, with negative tests. Preserve correct lower-case role IDs and existing exported API. Do not contact databases or inspect any real role names.

Pure synthetic GoTrue/Auth configuration receipt metadata: fail closed if a descriptor contains raw value, token, client_secret, password, private_key or nested credential payload; enforce unique key names and configured boolean, output summary counts only; test positive synthetic metadata and malicious raw-secret field cases. No actual credentials, Auth API or production reads.
